main_text.l: Cernens pusillum, spreuit, & impotensIrae tumentis, dira saeuisVocibus atq; cruces minatusIntentat hastam: sed Dauid occupat,Fundaq; paruo vulnere stupeaeMagnum Gigantem funeratumExuuiis spoliat superbis.
Sed plura molli dicere barbitoVetat tenella Musa potens Lyrae,Quae gestit heroas CothurnoMaeoniy resonare vatis.
EADEM DIE DVX GVI-SIVS INTERFECTVS QVA Rex Nauarrae natus.

VAE te nascentem, Rex, magni conscia partusOstendit terris, prima, Nauarre dies,Guisiadem ad stygias iussit penetrare paludes,Auctior ut duplici luce at usque nota.Nam te praesidium patriae dedit illa ruentiHic semper cuius pestis acerba fuit.

page.notes: Heading rule ornament and decorated initial O are not transcribed as text. Verse lines are reproduced as set; the initial letter of the first Latin stanza is a woodcut initial joined to "VAE". Some letterforms (long s, Greek-style ligatures such as "ꝗ" in "Quae") are read with caution.
